correctness.rationale: Convergent p-adic moment expansion is an exact consequence of the exponential generating function. The coefficient of base b has valuation (b-1)s. For even shift q, base 2 has valuation s+ell. If p-1 divides q, Fermat plus LTE forces every other unit base difference to have valuation at least ell, while its coefficient contributes at least 2s; if not, ell=0 and coefficients suffice. Nonunit bases vanish beyond n>=s+ell+1. Odd shifts differ modulo p. Primitive order of 2 modulo p^a yields the exact least eventual period. Standalone verifier replay passed 228 Stirling checks, 108 expansion checks, 1596 shift valuations and 45 period/minimality checks.

originality.rationale: Poonen (1988) and Mezo (2013) establish ordinary Fubini modular periodicity or restricted variants; neither treats block-color parameter t congruent to -1 modulo an odd prime. Mihoubi--Taharbouchet (2019) study exactly the same geometric polynomials and prove polynomial congruences modulo p, but their inspected Section 3 supplies neither exact p-adic valuations of every even shift nor all least eventual periods modulo prime powers. 2025 Schreyer deals with a distinct r-horse variant. The present p-adic shift valuation is not implied by these inspected statements. A plausible 2017 general congruence source was abstract-only and is a disclosed risk.
residual_risks: Diagana--Maiga (2017) generalized Fubini congruences: full text not accessible, and an unadvertised broader theorem could overlap.
Other later p-adic/geometric-polynomial congruence literature might contain an equivalent exact shifted-index valuation.
A negative index/database search is not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: Weighted ordered-partition polynomials are a natural colored combinatorial family. Determining all even-shift p-adic valuations and least eventual periods for every modulus p^a and infinitely many positive weights reveals a prime-power shortening law depending solely on valuation of t+1, beyond elementary parity or known weight-one periods. This is a complete structural classification in its stated natural regime.
